concerns.text: Tasks T024 and T025 contain broken Python string literals with unrendered citation placeholders ('...discussed in [Citation].') and missing closing quotes. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) as the code will fail to execute, preventing the FR-009/FR-010 memory constraints from being enforced.

Task T022b implements a 'Stratified-by-Class + Intra-Class Scaffold Split' algorithm. While the plan justifies this hybrid approach, the spec (FR-004) explicitly mandates a 'scaffold-based split'. The task silently replaces the spec's specific constraint with a different algorithm without explicit spec authorization, creating a traceability gap and potential constraint weakening.

Task T035a defines 'high-yield' as the 80th percentile of the validation set. SC-003 requires verifying substructures in '>80% of high-yield reactions'. The task's dynamic threshold definition (80th percentile) changes the metric's semantic meaning compared to the spec's likely intent of a fixed yield threshold (e.,g., >80% yield), risking failure to satisfy the success criterion's empirical intent.

FR-004 mandates logging the 'exact split ratios used in the final report'. While T022b outputs a split log, neither T010 nor T022b explicitly mandates generating a final log entry in `data/results/` that aggregates these ratios for the final report, risking a failure to meet the FR-004 logging requirement.
